Step 1. Analyze the question and identify the relevant metrics:
The relevant metrics for performing a linear prediction of the page cache memory currently being used by the containers of the admin user service on k8s-node2 are:
- The metric "container_memory_cache" represents the number of bytes of page cache memory. This metric is essential for predicting the page cache memory usage.
- The metric "container_memory_usage_bytes" indicates the current memory usage in bytes, including all memory regardless of when it was accessed. This metric can provide additional context for the memory usage.
